crossRefs.note: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and…
Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…
He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from…
for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…

translations.web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
translations.bsb: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
translations.kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
translations.asv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
